submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 2 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.866 ns among all nine configurations tested (3 mixtures × 3 gap sizes). This represents a significant performance improvement of 0.548 ns over Mixture-G2 at 2mm and 0.486 ns over Mixture-G3 at 2mm. The configuration meets all constraints: it uses one of the three candidate mixtures from candidate_specs.md, the 2 mm gap falls within the required 1-3 mm range, the gas system is compatible with laboratory environmental and safety policies (gas recirculation is available with 90% recovery, and all mixtures passed HV compatibility), and no mixtures were excluded by policy review. The systematic simulation across all gap sizes (1mm, 2mm, 3mm) for Mixture-G1 showed that 2mm provides optimal performance (better than 1.016 ns at 1mm and 0.992 ns at 3mm), making this the clear choice for achieving the best possible time resolution as required by the project goal.
